before.name: Jordan W. Rincker
before.description: Jordan W. Rincker was arrested on June 21, 2026 and accused of distributing money, transferring a shotgun, and accepting equipment connected to an anti-government plot to attack the UFC Freedom 250 event at the White House. A federal grand jury later charged him and seven others with conspiracy to provide material support to terrorists and conspiracy to commit murder. He remained in federal custody while the case was pending.
